items.label: SUPER WB+17 [N0]
items.why: The release's boot program: Nostalgia's intro and its trainer menu, then the game's resident code, packed, which it unpacks into the resident part before the title screen asks for load 1.

items.label: DOCS SUPER  [N0]
items.why: The release's instructions for the game, a program of their own that Nostalgia added; the game never loads it.

also: side1: {C2}   S U P E R  {C2}
items.why: Directory art: the release's title drawn in the disk's directory as zero-block DEL entries whose first sector is the directory track itself, so their bytes are the directory's own sectors. The game never loads them.

items.label: 20-SWB
items.why: The high score: three packed-decimal bytes loaded to $4DBE-$4DC0. The release's high-score saver (its info file lists a Highsaver) writes them back from $2B75 when a new record is set.

items.label: 01-SWB
items.why: Load 1, the title screen and round 1, packed: the resident loader at $7A6E unpacks it to $7EDF-$BE6B (the round's code, map and tables) and $EB40-$FABF (its sprites).

items.label: 02-SWB
items.why: Load 2, packed: the resident loader at $7A6E unpacks two streams, to $7EDF-$BF81 (the area's code, map and tables) and $EB40-$F9BF (its sprites); stream-boundaries.json has the byte counts. The last 90 bytes of the file come after the second stream's end marker, and the decoder stops before them.
